newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden finance body says watching funds case.
newsitem.headline: Sweden finance body says watching funds case.

text.p: Swedish finance inspectors on Friday said they had not taken any action or put any questions to the Swedish companies involved in the Morgan Grenfell funds probe but declined to elaborate further.
"We are staying in touch with the Nordic and British supervisory authoriites," Ull-Reet Jakobsson, head of the country's financial market regulation body Finansinspektionen, told Reuters.

On Friday the Norwegian Banking, Securities and Insurance Commission announced it had launched an investigation into Oslo-based FIBA Nordic Securities AS and its cooperation with Fiba Nordic Securities of London.
Fiba Nordic Securities in London is in the storm over holdings of three temporarily-suspended Morgan Grenfell European investment funds.
Several listed and unlisted Swedish companies were held by the funds under investigation.
Morgan Grenfell earlier on Friday announced that it may hold up to 57 percent of the A-share of Swedish development company Sintercast AB.
Sintercast shares were 20 crowns lower at 250 crowns at 1330 GMT.
